findings.clause_quote: On each anniversary of the Effective Date, Carrier may adjust the unit rates set out in Section 3.2 by no more than five percent (5.0%) of the rate in effect immediately before that anniversary, compounded annually over the Term.
findings.explanation: FR-200 billed at $107.84 per unit; after 2 full contract year(s) the agreement allows at most $105.84.

dispute_email.subject: Invoice INV-1001 — rate increase above the contract ceiling
dispute_email.body:
Hello,

We reviewed invoice INV-1001 dated 2026-07-10 against our Master Services Agreement.
Expedited next-day delivery (SKU FR-200) is billed at $107.84 per unit, while Section 7.2 allows no more than $105.84 per unit after two annual adjustments.

- FR-200: 2,090 units billed at $107.84, $221,205.60 allowed, overcharge $4,180.00 (Section 7.2)

Total overcharge: $4,180.00

Please send a corrected invoice or credit memo for $4,180.00.

Accounts Payable
